spans.s:
(ई) वृजी r. 1st cl. (वर्जति) 2nd cl. (वृक्ते) 7th cl. (वृणक्ति) 10th cl. (वर्ज्जयति)
1 To quit, to shun, to avoid, to except, to abandon.
2 (In the 7th cl.) To cover.
With अप,
To relinquish.

Sky, atmosphere.
m. (-नः)
Hair.
E.
वृज to quit, &c., Uṇādi aff. क्यु.

f. (-जिः)
A country, probably that to the west of Dehli and Agra, or the modern Bruj.
E.
वृज to quit, aff. कि.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of the district of Vrij or Bruj, (as a dialect, a native, &c.)
E.
वृजि as above, and कन् added.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Crooked, bent, curved.
2 Wicked.
n. (-नं)
1 Sin, vice, wickedness.
2 Red leather.
3 Distress, affliction.
m. (-नः)
Hair.
E.
वृज to cover, Uṇādi aff. इनच्. and the vowel unchanged.
